Forums where milpac mentions are suppressed
Ticket categories where milpac mentions are suppressed

Select the forums where a milpac link should raise no alert. The link still renders, still resolves, and the $name completer still works there; only the notification is withheld. A forum you leave unselected alerts as it always has. Nothing is selected by default.

Select the ticket categories where a milpac link should raise no alert. The link still renders and still resolves, so the ticket keeps its record of which member it is about; only the notification is withheld. Selected by default: S1 Citations (17), Medal Recommendations (18), Medal Approvals (20) and Medal posting (21). In those queues the linked milpac names the member an award is about rather than someone being addressed, so the alert tells a member about their own pending award. Needs NF/Tickets.
Places where a milpac link raises no alert. The link still renders and still resolves everywhere; these lists withhold the notification only.
